task.pr_title: Intel 8080 parallel interface HIL, Bus library with I2C, SPI and Intel 8080 parallel interface implementation

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: I don't like this practice of treating an arbitrary memory location as though it is an `FsmcBank`. This could easily lead to memory unsafety if these slots were used. If empty slots are needed in the FSMC array, the array should hold `Option<StaticRef<FsmcBank>>`
